description: This source file defines classes and static data for representing and handling PDF content stream operators in the PDFsharp library, including operator descriptions, enumeration, and lookup methods.

classes.name: OpCode
classes.description: Represents a PDF content stream operator description with properties like name, opcode, operands, postscript, flags, and description.

classes.name: OpCodes
classes.description: Static class containing all PDF operator codes, their descriptions, and a method to retrieve operators by name.

methods.name: OperatorFromName
methods.description: Returns a COperator instance corresponding to the operator name, using a lookup dictionary.
